name: Life Calculation
definition: Estimate of the number of terms to maturity, taking the possibility of early payments into account.

Years.name: Years
Years.definition: Result of the life calculation measured in number of years.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date/time on which the calculation is based, for example, valuation on October 1 (price date) based on price of September 19 ( value date).

ValuePeriod.name: Value Period
ValuePeriod.definition: Period on which the calculation is based.

SecuritiesPricing.name: Securities Pricing
SecuritiesPricing.definition: Securities pricing for which a life calculation is specified.

VariableInterest.name: Variable Interest
VariableInterest.definition: Variable interest used for the calculation.
